jobs.description:
Are you a CE driver who enjoys being on the road but wants to be home every evening? For a growing transport company in Desteldonk (Ghent), we are looking for a motivated CE driver for shuttle and regional work.

You can count on a clear schedule, a stable work structure and daily departure from Desteldonk. After successfully completing the Ecodrive, you will also receive a company car for private use.

Your job

• Carry out shuttle and distribution trips for various customers (no shops, only industrial companies)
• Mainly drive within the Ghent region
• Transport goods safely and on time
• Loading and unloading is only occasionally done by you via the loading dock or curtain side; warehouse staff usually take care of this
• Provide professional and customer-oriented service
• Possibility to work for a fixed customer, offering extra structure and regularity
• Start each day from Desteldonk
• No overnight stays – home every evening

• You have a valid CE driving licence and some initial experience as a driver
• You are punctual, responsible and customer-oriented
• You work safely and professionally
• You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are motivated and proud of your profession
• You are available to start between 5:00 and 6:00 AM

You will work in a professional environment with a clear schedule, fixed arrangements and personal support. Safety, reliability and quality service are key. After successfully completing the Ecodrive, you will also receive a company car for private use.

Your job

• Warehouse staff can take over loading and unloading when needed
• Provide professional and customer-oriented service

• Possibility to work for a fixed customer, providing extra structure and regularity

• You have a valid CE driving licence and some initial experience as a driver
• You are punctual, responsible and customer-oriented

• You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are motivated and proud of your profession

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Job Description

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Your Role
 
• Design, implement, and improve automated unit and regression tests 
• Apply AI-assisted development tools to accelerate code migration, test generation, 
refactoring, and documentation
 
• Establish and monitor code coverage metrics 
• Integrate testing, coverage analysis, and regression checks into the existing CI/CD pipeline 
• Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize future software migration efforts 
• Use and improve best practices for integrating AI coding assistants into software modernization workflows 
• Collaborate with senior software developers and imaging experts to validate functionality and quality 
Your Profile
 
• Bachelor's or Master's student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
• Strong affinity with software development, testing, automation and development infrastructure 
• Experience with C++ development, experience with other programming languages is a plus 
• Familiarity with git and CI/CD concepts is an asset 
• Curious and eager to explore new tools, technologies, and environments 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English/Dutch and a collaborative mindset

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – SAP CRM & S/4HANA
jobs.description:

At Allseas, we enable the development of groundbreaking offshore solutions that support the energy transition. Our success depends on making informed decisions, managing resources effectively, and continuously improving the way we operate.
 

Within Business Finance, we act as trusted partners to the business, enabling sustainable performance through cost transparency, financial planning, data-driven insights, and strong financial governance. We challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and support the business in turning strategy into results.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a 
Finance Business Partner for Crewing.
 

 
 

Your role
 

 
 

As Finance Business Partner for Crewing, you will support one of the most critical functions within Allseas: ensuring our vessels are staffed with the right people, at the right time, and at the right cost.
 

You will partner closely with Crewing, Vessel Management, Human Resources, and Operations leadership, providing financial insight and decision support that enables effective workforce planning, cost management, and operational performance.
 

You will act as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts, challenge assumptions, evaluate opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

Business Partnering & Decision Support
 
 

• Partner with Crewing and Vessel Management to support operational and strategic decision-making. 

• Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and actionable recommendations. 

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilization. 

• Challenge assumptions and support management in making informed decisions.  

Financial Planning & Performance Management
 
 

• Lead budgeting and forecasting activities. 

• Monitor financial performance and analyse variances against budget and forecast. 

• Provide timely insights into cost drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.  

Cost Transparency & Reporting
 
 

• Deliver reliable and business-relevant financial reporting. 

• Develop and enhance management dashboards and performance analyses.  

Process Improvement & Financial Governance
 
 

• Safeguard data integrity and compliance with financial standards and policies. 

• Identify and implement improvements in end-to-end business processes, systems (SAP, PowerBI) 

You are curious, analytical, and eager to understand how the business operates. You enjoy working with stakeholders across different disciplines and can translate complex data into practical business insights.
 

You also have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and help drive positive change.
 

Qualifications:
 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• 5 years of experience in Business Finance, Financial Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering. 

• Experience in a project-driven, engineering, offshore, maritime, or international environment is an advantage.  

Skills:
 
 

• Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Ability to influence and challenge constructively. 

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and business case development. 

• Strong affinity with digital reporting solutions and data analytics. 

• Experience with SAP and Power BI is preferred. 

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

• Administration support : travels arrangements, expense claims, contacts, follow up holiday planning CCT members, Country Chair budget set up and monitoring, etc. 
 
• Communication support.. 
 
• Meetings planning, logistics preparations, minutes sharing with staff. 
 
• Support Social Investments plan and track execution. 
 
• Events preparation support : staff party, Family Day,... 
 
•   

You graduated recently or you already have a first work experience in a similar function.
 

You have excellent communication in English, French & Dutch (spoken/written).
 

You have strong administrative skills and excellent knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager – Biometric Identity Systems
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Supervise internal development teams and external service providers to ensure the delivery of forensic expertise modules.
• Manage technical and functional dependencies between various integrated systems and existing national databases.

• Monitor project milestones, consolidated schedules, and quality control processes for external procurement contracts.

• 8+ years of experience in project management and coordinating multi-stakeholder programs.
• 3+ years of experience with information systems architecture, business applications, and complex system integration.
• You possess a solid background in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps methodologies.
• You bring experience with software lifecycle management including testing, validation, and software acceptance processes.
• You have proficiency in collaboration and management tools such as Jira, Open Project, and GitLab.
• You possess the ability to lead heterogeneous teams and manage priorities in high-pressure environments.
• You bring strong analytical skills and the capacity to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
• You are proactive, solution-oriented, and demonstrate strong leadership skills.

• Onboard teams to new AI capabilities through workshops, demonstrations, and hands-on sessions.
• Measure and collect user feedback to drive continuous improvement of the platform.
• Assess internal and external AI capabilities to provide recommendations for future enhancements.
• Maintain clear documentation ensuring traceability from business requirements to technical implementation.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in functional analysis, requirements engineering, and process modeling.
• You bring technical knowledge of LLM harnesses, agent workflows, RAG, and prompt engineering.
• You possess a solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure tools such as Azure, Kubernetes, and Terraform.
• You're skilled in designing test scenarios and automated evaluations for model behavior and tool integration.
• You have experience inspecting logs and agent execution traces to debug issues related to token usage, context, and latency.
• You're proactive and solution-oriented with a proven track record in stimulating user adoption and onboarding.
• You are fluent in English.
Nice to Haves

• Development experience in Python and TypeScript.
• Knowledge of Figma and design thinking practices.
• Experience with Targetprocess or similar Agile project management platforms.
• Familiarity with digital user experience, web design, or marketing content design.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - Saturday or weekdays
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.
